Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Interface TcpClientEventHandler

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    TcpClientEventAdapter
    public interface TcpClientEventHandler
    Defines event callbacks for monitoring the operation of a TcpClient.

    A TCP client event handler may be registered with a client to receive notifications about connection lifecycle events, reconnect attempts, sent and received agents, and received replies. Implementing this interface is optional and is not required for normal TCP client operation.

    Applications interested in only a subset of these events may extend TcpClientEventAdapter instead of implementing every method in this interface.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    TcpClient, TcpClientEventAdapter, TcpServer
